name: manual_4c5caf
claim: When exporting a candidate tree for tests that inspect repository identity, initialize a scratch Git repository and record the exported tree before interpreting failures.

decisions.notes: Claude reported 25 false failures in an export without Git metadata; restoring that precondition reproduced the 3214 producer and 3087 producer-free passing suites. Gossip event 30b4b2a1f3fd43c7b43a82cc3e7044be; attributed independent evidence, not a new operator run.
